governingSpec: dispatch://LEGSMOKE-967/spec (the child's own spec document is empty)

implement: legion-worker: references/pr-body.md (PR template, what a proof is; a Markdown-only diff gets no simplify pass and omits the Thermo line) and references/default-branch-check.md (identity check before each push). The repository ships no skills, AGENTS.md, manifest, linter or tests.
test: legion-worker: references/pr-body.md (the tester verifies the implementer's proof and drives the surface independently through the GitHub contents and git objects APIs; CI is read at the code head, never re-run) and references/merge-gate.md (which head's checks count).
review: legion-worker: references/merge-gate.md (review order; approval of the head, stating K) and references/review-threads.md (one disposition per thread; the one appended line is requested only by a review on the pull request).

findings.finding: The issue's deliverable is undefined: the driver asked only for a pushed plan handoff while the root spec asks for a marker file reviewed in a pull request; which path this 'fallback' rehearsal takes only the owner can settle.
findings.answer: Plan section 'How far this issue runs': the plan covers the whole path; every criterion binds to a head that exists only once its phase has run; a plan-only outcome leaves the branch holding only .legion/LEGSMOKE-970/plan.json and makes no claim on C1/C3/C4/C5. Named to the architect in the completion summary.

findings.finding: Which key names the file is ambiguous: the root spec says 'this issue' but the branch is the child's.
findings.answer: Decision 1: smoke/LEGSMOKE-970.md naming LEGSMOKE-970, as all 42 precedents key the marker by the branch's own issue; siblings 971/972 write disjoint paths, so no forward merge is expected.

findings.finding: No Acceptance section exists anywhere; the plan is the only checkable document.
findings.answer: Criteria C1–C5 with surface, exact command, expected output and negative control; the plan is the acceptance of record and the child spec stays empty unless the architect populates it.

findings.finding: The marker text has no documented source beyond the title minus its fixture clause.
findings.answer: Decision 2 pins the literal byte-for-byte (47 bytes, LF, no BOM/CRLF, blob sha1 08abbb01…), states the derivation rule, keeps 'child', drops ' (/tmp/legion-e2e4b.1357539.ifXgUL5l)'; no later role re-derives it.

findings.finding: 'Nothing else changes' collides with Legion's own .legion/ handoff commits.
findings.answer: Decision 4 and C2: .legion/ excluded from the diff criterion mid-run, zero .legion/ paths at the READY head R and in the squash merge commit M; a branch holding only handoff commits satisfies the sentence trivially.

findings.finding: CI evidence may bind to a head that has no checks (handoff-only pushes get zero check-runs).
findings.answer: C3: CI binds to the code head H and retro's head R only; gate is the only required context, check informational; no CI claim is made for a handoff-only head.

findings.finding: The production surface is undefined for a rehearsal that may never merge.
findings.answer: Section 'Production-like surface': production is main of sjawhar/legion-smoke after the daemon's squash merge; C5 names the exact reads at M and ?ref=main with expected bytes; before the merge the production-like read is the contents API at a branch head.

findings.finding: The optional appended line is unspecified in trigger, text and cap.
findings.answer: Decision 5: K in {0,1}; triggered only by a REQUEST_CHANGES review or a review thread from the reviewer on the pull request; default text 'Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)'; one-line cap; anything else goes to the architect; K is 0 while no pull request exists.

findings.finding: Base drift and concurrent siblings are unaddressed.
findings.answer: Decision 10 and C1(a): base pinned to B = a0c7ce50…; disjoint paths mean no rebase or forward merge while MERGEABLE; absence control pinned at B and re-read at the then-current main with its SHA recorded; 'nothing else changes' measured on M against its one parent.

findings.finding: Several planning facts rest on command output the analyst could not see (blob sha1s, base SHA, ruleset contexts, contents-API probes, skip-checks behaviour).
findings.answer: Section 'Production-like surface' lists each fact with the command that produced it, marked to be re-run at implement time; the cmp against the literal is binding and a sha1 mismatch is reported as a plan bug, not re-cut.
